data.title: World Tennis and Generali seal new expanded partnership to power global participation
data.description:
World Tennis and Generali seal new expanded partnership to power global participation

World Tennis and Generali seal new expanded partnership to power global participation

PR Newswire

BOLOGNA, Italy, Nov. 27, 2026
  • Targeting global player growth of +20 million by 2035
  • Goal to introduce tennis to over 1 million young people annually

BOLOGNA, Italy, Nov. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- World Tennis and Generali have signed a new and amplified multi-year partnership to expand the global growth of tennis and build more active communities worldwide.

The deal enhances the collaboration between the organisations, following the announcement of Generali's landmark Davis Cup presenting partnership in September.

The expanded agreement will bring significant investment into flagship World Tennis programmes that empower people to enjoy the sport from the Junior Tennis Initiative to the Masters Tour, as well as national tennis infrastructure, coach development, mass participation and new grassroots initiatives.

The partnership is built on a shared belief in the power of physical activity to improve lives and support longevity while concretely helping to build towards World Tennis' global participation growth target of +20 million tennis players by 2035.*

Generali has strong foundations in supporting active lifestyles across tennis, running, football and winter sports. In tennis this includes title sponsorship of the Generali Open in Kitzbühel and a partnership with Dominic Thiem in Austria, sponsorship of the Rolex Monte Carlo Masters event and partnerships with the Real Federación Española de Tenis (RFET) and Deutsche Tennis Bund (DTB), as well as the global presenting partnership with Davis Cup announced in September.

In line with Generali's Lifetime Partner proposition, the Group strongly believes that people who are more active and more connected live healthier, happier and more fulfilling lives. Generali's targeted sports partnerships allow the Group to bring this belief to life, creating opportunities for people to move more by removing barriers to participation and encouraging healthier lifestyles. This also brings people together, creating meaningful connections and strengthening communities through shared experiences, ultimately helping everyone live better everywhere the Group operates.

The partnership with World Tennis will support a range of grassroots initiatives, building on World Tennis' existing programmes, Junior and Masters initiatives, as well as developing new ones, all delivered in collaboration with World Tennis' vast global network of 214 member National Associations with the goal to make the sport more accessible and increase participation across ages supporting longevity, health, wellbeing and connections within communities.

*Based on projected growth from 106 million players in 2024 (reported in Global Tennis Data Report) and current trajectory towards World Tennis participation target of 140 million players by 2035.

Initial overview of relevant programmes

1)  Generali World Tennis Masters Tour

A truly global tennis community of over 42,000 players competing in over 650 events per year in 75 countries – including the prestigious World Team and Individual Championships. The focus is on providing opportunities for players aged 30-100. Through this partnership, World Tennis is targeting a 10% increase in tournaments and players in 2027 and further growth from 2028 onwards.

2)  Generali Junior Tennis Initiative

Through World Tennis' global network of National Associations, 131 countries are currently supported through the Junior Tennis Initiative (JTI). The JTI provides young people with their first opportunity to experience tennis through schools, clubs and local communities. Together with Generali, World Tennis will expand the influence of the JTI in more countries in 2027, with a goal to introduce tennis to over one-million young people annually.

3)  Generali Coaches For Life

Support for and access to coach education programmes and scholarships that empower the mentors behind every player.

4)  Generali World Tennis Activation

Mass participation initiatives in key Generali markets through the February and September Davis Cup by Generali ties; turning the prestigious global event into a local engagement opportunity.

5)  Generali Rally Together Fund

Ringfenced funding for investment into new tennis facilities, infrastructure and national training centres across the world.

Ross Hutchins, World Tennis Chief Executive, said: "We are proud to deepen our collaboration with Generali, which is based on shared core values and a belief in the power of physical activity. Our Davis Cup partnership already allows meaningful engagement with local communities and nations across the world. This expanded new agreement will further empower our flagship programmes that support people to access our sport and its proven health benefits regardless of age, gender or background. Generali strongly believes in the potential of those programmes in line with their commitment to support physical wellbeing to strengthen connection and belonging in communities.

"When we became World Tennis this year, we stated our mission: to create a world of opportunities through tennis both on and off the court. We know that tennis can build stronger communities and allows people to live healthier, happier, longer lives worldwide. Now we have the chance to further harness that power as we build towards our target of 20 million new players by 2035."

Generali Group CEO, Philippe Donnet, said: "As a Lifetime Partner, Generali is committed to helping people build a more secure and sustainable future by supporting initiatives that enhance wellbeing and strengthen communities. Sponsorships play an important role in this commitment, providing meaningful opportunities to connect with people through shared passions and experiences. Among the many sports we support, tennis stands out for its universal appeal, strong values and positive impact on physical and mental wellbeing across all generations.

"The new and expanded partnership with World Tennis marks an important step in combining our support for high level competitions with grassroots initiatives that create opportunities for many more people to play, connect and thrive through sport. Together with World Tennis, we look forward to helping grow the game and contributing to healthier, more connected communities that can live better, and longer lives."

data.title: Trutankless®, Inc. Strengthens Balance Sheet, Converts Approximately $5 Million in Notes into Equity
data.description:
Trutankless®, Inc. Strengthens Balance Sheet, Converts Approximately $5 Million in Notes into Equity

Trutankless®, Inc. Strengthens Balance Sheet, Converts Approximately $5 Million in Notes into Equity

PR Newswire

SCOTTSDALE, Ariz., Nov. 27, 2026

Conversion eliminates more than $400,000 in annual interest expense as nine-month net sales rise 146% to a record

SCOTTSDALE, Ariz., Nov. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Trutankless®, Inc. (OTC: TKLS), the Company known for its GEN3-series of smart electric tankless water heaters, today announced that its noteholders have converted approximately $5,000,000 in notes into equity. The conversion eliminates more than $400,000 in annual interest expense on the notes. Additional details are included in a Current Report on Form 8-K that the Company filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on November 24, 2026.

The conversion builds on prior debt-to-equity conversions, including approximately $3 million in April 2024, and continues the Company's plan to strengthen its capital structure while aligning investors with the growth of the brand. For plumbing technicians and wholesale partners, that means a manufacturer with more room to invest in inventory, training and support.

The conversion comes as demand accelerates. The Company reported that net sales for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, rose 146% to a record $1,841,929, compared to $748,491 for the same period in 2025. Third quarter net sales grew 62% year over year to $362,790.

Trutankless® continues to expand its wholesale distribution partner network and contractor relationships nationwide, with particularly strong momentum in Arizona, Texas and Florida. Its 14,000-square-foot North Phoenix facility, opened in October 2025, brings production, engineering, installer training and distribution under one roof. In April, it launched the GEN3 Commercial 208V unit, engineered for condominiums, multi-family housing, salons, restaurants, fitness studios and other light commercial settings.

GEN3+, the next generation of the Trutankless® smart electric tankless water heater, is now in production and shipping. The wireless connected unit works with the Trutankless® connected app for homeowners and the Trutankless® Pro app and Pro dashboard for plumbing professionals, all now in beta. The Company plans to share full GEN3+ details in December.

"This conversion strengthens our balance sheet and lets us put more of our resources behind growth," said Guy Newman, CEO of Trutankless®. "Nine-month sales are up 146%, our distributor and contractor network keeps growing, and our Phoenix facility gives us room to scale. With GEN3+ now shipping and our Pro app and Pro dashboard in beta, we are giving plumbing professionals the tools to support every system they install."

About Trutankless®

Trutankless® is the premier brand in electric tankless water heating. The award-winning brand's GEN3 and GEN3+ lineup delivers endless, on-demand hot water in a sleek, space-saving design for homes, condos, multi-family and light commercial spaces.

The Trutankless® connected app is designed to put performance insights and preventative maintenance alerts in the hands of homeowners and plumbing pros, keeping every system running at peak performance, maximizing energy efficiency and extending its service life.

Trutankless® products are sold through plumbing wholesale distributors and dealers nationwide. Founded in 2008, Trutankless®, Inc. (OTC: TKLS) is headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona. Learn more at www.trutankless.com.

Forward-Looking Statements: The statements in this press release regarding expected interest savings, sales growth, the features and availability of GEN3+, the availability of the Company's connected apps, and any implied or perceived benefits from the conversion are forward-looking statements. Such statements involve risks and uncertainties, including the performance of the Company's sales partners, product development and launch timing, legal and regulatory matters, competition, and general economic conditions, that could cause actual results to differ materially from those expressed or implied. The Company undertakes no obligation to update these statements. Past performance is not indicative of future results.

data.title: Nine Line Apparel Releases Guide Examining Why Patriotic Fashion Remains Popular Among Americans
data.description:
SAVANNAH, GA / ACCESS Newswire / November 27, 2026 / Nine Line Apparel has released an informational guide titled "Why Patriotic Fashion Remains Popular Among Americans." The guide examines the factors that keep patriotic apparel relevant across generations and outlines practical considerations for consumers selecting patriotic clothes for everyday wear rather than only for national holidays.

The guide identifies five factors behind the continued popularity of patriotic fashion: personal expression, national identity, military heritage, everyday versatility, and brand values. Each factor is presented as a distinct section, and together they explain why apparel featuring American symbols, flag graphics, and service-related messages continues to appeal to a broad range of Americans.

On personal expression, the guide notes that clothing choices often communicate something about a wearer's personality. Colors, graphics, and symbols can reflect interests and beliefs without verbal explanation. According to the guide, wearing patriotic clothes is more than a style decision for many Americans. An American flag shirt may represent national pride, respect for military service, or a personal connection to the country's history. The guide observes that consumers can choose a subtle design for daily wear or a bold graphic that makes their views more visible. It also points out that patriotic fashion does not require adherence to specific trends or style rules, which helps explain its appeal to people of all ages.

The section on national identity describes how patriotic apparel provides a tangible way for individuals to connect with a larger community. Family traditions, history, and personal experience shape how people perceive the country, and American symbols often carry personal meaning. The guide notes that the stars and stripes may recall a family member who served in the military, a memorable national celebration, or values associated with freedom and independence. These associations give patriotic apparel an emotional dimension beyond its appearance. The guide adds that patriotic designs remain relevant outside national holidays and are commonly worn to baseball games, weekend barbecues, community events, and casual outings.

The guide's third section addresses military heritage and its imprint on American fashion. Uniform-inspired elements, service-related messages, military-themed graphics, and flag imagery hold meaning for those who respect the armed forces. Veterans, active-duty personnel, military families, and civilian supporters can all find significance in these styles. The guide also discusses veteran-owned brands, noting that their founders bring experience and knowledge of military culture to their businesses. Military-style clothing, according to the guide, appeals to civilians who value traits such as discipline, courage, and dedication, including first responders and their supporters. This broad identification explains why patriotic themes resonate beyond the military community.

Everyday versatility forms the fourth section. The guide describes how patriotic apparel fits into ordinary routines: a graphic T-shirt pairs with jeans, a hoodie can be worn on a colder morning, and a patriotic cap complements casual attire. The guide references a range of product types, including men's and women's T-shirts, tank tops, sweatshirts, caps, and accessories, with design options ranging from small flag graphics to larger statement pieces. Comfort is identified as a key factor in how often a garment is worn. The guide notes that cotton shirts offer a familiar feel, while triblend fabrics provide another option for casual clothing. It recommends that consumers evaluate fabric, fit, stitching, and print quality to select products that suit their routines and remain useful beyond a single event.

The final section examines how brand values and product quality influence purchasing decisions. The guide states that some shoppers prefer veteran-owned businesses to support entrepreneurs with military experience, while others seek companies that contribute to charitable causes or support veterans and military families. Veteran-owned apparel companies often combine patriotic designs with community-focused initiatives, and their product ranges may include graphic shirts, hoodies, headwear, bags, and lifestyle accessories. Military-style clothing and other patriotic designs from these companies can carry added meaning because of the brand's background.

The guide places equal emphasis on product quality. It advises consumers to review size charts, fabric details, product descriptions, and return policies before purchasing. It also cautions against assuming that every product from a patriotic brand is manufactured in the United States, encouraging buyers to review product details to ensure their purchases meet expectations.

In its conclusion, the guide states that patriotic fashion remains popular because it connects personal expression with national pride, military heritage, and everyday style. It notes that comfortable products and purpose-driven brands help sustain consumer interest. The guide recommends that consumers look beyond graphics alone and consider comfort, fit, product quality, and brand background when choosing patriotic clothes, selecting items that suit their daily routines and reflect what matters to them.

The guide is intended as an informational resource for consumers interested in the cultural, personal, and practical aspects of patriotic apparel, from the symbolism of American imagery to the details of garment construction.

About Nine Line Apparel

Nine Line Apparel is an apparel company based in Savannah, United States. The company produces patriotic apparel, including graphic T-shirts, hoodies, headwear, and accessories that feature American symbols and military-inspired themes. Nine Line Apparel also publishes informational content on patriotic fashion and its connection to national pride and military heritage.

data.title: The warnings behind this week's stock-market rally
data.description:
By Philip van Doorn

Also in Weekend Reads: Important tips for Medicare enrollment, how to spot online shopping scams and marital advice from The Moneyist

Investors showed their approval of Jensen Huang's return as CEO of Nvidia as the stock soared on Monday. But even with a strong rally in the broad indexes, investors are facing political and credit-market challenges.

You might be relieved to see your retirement-account balances rebounding this week, but the broad stock market's rally may signal underlying challenges in the coming weeks.

Investors started this week by celebrating the return of Jensen Huang as CEO of Nvidia (NVDA), who resigned from the position on Nov. 12. His return led to a 31.5% increase for Nvidia's stock on Monday, which followed a 22.9% decline the previous week through Friday, Nov. 20. The S&P 500 SPX was down 8.6% that week.

Nvidia is the third-largest component of the S&P 500 SPX, with a market capitalization of $3.60 trillion as of Wednesday's close, according to FactSet.

The Nvidia news fed a broad rally on Monday, with the S&P 500 rising 4.7%, only to reverse with a 0.8% decline for the index over the next two days, and reverse again with an increase of 1.6% on Friday. For the week, the large-cap U.S. benchmark index was up 5.6%.

data.title: Sol-Gel Technologies to Host Conference Call to Discuss Top-Line Results from Pivotal Phase 3 Clinical Trial of SGT-610 in Gorlin Syndrome
data.description:
NESS ZIONA, Israel, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Sol-Gel Technologies, Ltd. (NASDAQ: SLGL), a dermatology company, pioneering treatments for patients with rare and severe skin conditions, today announced that it will host a conference call on Monday, November 30, 2026, at 8:00am Eastern Time to discuss top-line results from its pivotal Phase 3 clinical trial (SGT-610-01) evaluating SGT-610 (patidegib gel, 2%) for the prevention of basal cell carcinoma lesions in adult patients with Gorlin syndrome. The Company plans to issue a press release announcing the top-line results at 7:00am Eastern Time on Monday, November 30, 2026, prior to the start of the conference call.

To access the live webcast of the call, please click here or visit the "Events" section of Sol-Gel’s website. To access the call by phone, please use this registration link, and you will be provided with dial in details. A replay of the call will be available approximately 2 hours after the conclusion of the call and archived for 90 days under the "Events " section of the Company's website at http://www.sol-gel.com.

About Sol-Gel Technologies

Sol-Gel is a specialized dermatology company advancing innovative therapies for rare and serious skin diseases. Its lead investigational candidate, SGT-610 (patidegib gel, 2%), is a Phase 3, orphan- and breakthrough-designated topical hedgehog inhibitor being developed for the prevention of new basal cell carcinoma (BCC) lesions in patients with Gorlin syndrome, with the potential to offer an improved safety profile relative to oral hedgehog inhibitors. Subject to regulatory approval in Gorlin syndrome, SGT-610 may also represent a future opportunity in high-frequency BCC. Sol-Gel is also advancing SGT-210, an investigational topical EGFR inhibitor for indications with significant unmet need, and has developed two FDA-approved dermatology products, TWYNEO® and EPSOLAY®.

data.title: Ricky Martin and Mya Come Together to Perform at AHF’s Sold out 40th Anniversary World AIDS Day Concert
data.description:
Ricky Martin and Mya Come Together to Perform at AHF’s Sold out 40th Anniversary World AIDS Day Concert

Multi-award-winning global star and philanthropist, Ricky Martin and Grammy Award winning singer, songwriter and producer, Mya will come together to perform at the Annual World AIDS Day benefit concert presented by AIDS Healthcare Foundation (AHF). Scheduled for the evening of Monday, November 30, 2026, at the Kia Forum in Inglewood, California, the sold-out event will also commemorate the organizations 40th anniversary of global impact in the fight against HIV/AIDS.

As a part of the evening’s festivities the organization will also present the Dolores Huerta Social Justice Award. The award, named in recognition of Huerta's extraordinary lifetime commitment to civil rights, social justice, and community empowerment, will recognize individuals whose leadership, courage, and service reflect the principles that have defined her remarkable legacy. The recipient of this year’s inaugural award will be the Honorable Lindsey Horvath, Los Angeles County Supervisor, Third District.

Beyond their global recognition as artists, both Ricky and Mya continue to use their platform for important causes. Mya, is involved in several charitable and social causes, particularly HIV/AIDS awareness, youth empowerment, animal welfare, and healthy living. She joined AHF in 2023 to perform to a packed audience in Atlanta, Georgia for the organizations annual AIDS Walk 5K & Music Festival, helping to raise close to $1 million dollars in the support for HIV/AIDS prevention and treatment services in the local community. Martin continues to bring greater awareness and support for various issues around HIV/AIDS, human trafficking, and LGBTQIA+ rights. He joined AHF in 2023 to perform to a sold-out crowd as the headliner for the organization’s World AIDS Day concert at the Watsco Center at the University of Miami (UM) in Coral Gables, Florida.

AHF is returning to the Kia Forum to present this year’s commemoration and celebrate its 40th anniversary. AHF held its event at the iconic venue in 2021 when celebrating the organization’s 35th anniversary, which featured Christina Aguliera and Jennifer Hudson.

WHAT:

AHF’S 40th ANNIVERSARY AND ANNUAL WORLD AIDS DAY BENEFIT CONCERT

 

WHEN:

MONDAY, NOVEMBER 30, 2026 7:00PM PST

NOTE: MEDIA CHECK-IN WILL START AT 5:30PM PST

 

WHERE:

KIA FORUM, 3900 W. MANCHESTER BLVD, INGLEWOOD, CA

 

WHO:

RICKY MARTIN, MULTI-AWARD-WINNING GLOBAL STAR AND PHILANTHROPIST

MYA, GRAMMY AWARD WINNING SINGER, SONGWRITER AND PRODYCER

THE HONORABLE LINDSEY HORVATH. LOS ANGELES COUNTY SUPERVISOR, THIRD DISTRICT

MICHAEL WEINSTEIN, AHF PRESIDENT

DR. CONDESSA CURLEY, AHF BOARD CHAIR

THOUSANDS OF ATTENDEES INCLUDING INDIVIDUALS LIVING WITH HIV

OBTAINING MEDIA CREDENTIALS: FOR SECURITY PURPOSES, ALL MEDIA PLANNING TO COVER THE EVENT PLEASE SEND AN EMAIL TO GED KENSLEA AT GED.KENSLEA@AHF.ORG. CREDENTIALS CAN BE PICKED UP STARTING AT 5:30PM PST AT THE MEDIA CHECK-IN TABLE AT THE MAIN ENTRANCE TO THE KIA FORUM.

Commemorated annually on December 1st, World AIDS Day is an international observance held to raise awareness of the HIV/AIDS epidemic, show support for people living with HIV, and remember those who have died from AIDS-related illnesses. Since, 2016, AHF’s World AIDS Day commemoration, under the slogan of Keep the Promise, has been presented in cities across the country, including Dallas, Atlanta, New York, Washington, D.C. and Houston. To heighten broader public awareness to the on-going impact of the global epidemic, and the work still to be done, the organization has previously worked with acclaimed director/choreographer, Debbie Allen to produce the show and over the last decade, partnered with a diverse array of performing artists such as Mariah Carey, Common, Janet Jackson, Patti LaBelle, Jennifer Holliday, Diana Ross and Gladys Knight to perform at the annual event.

According to recent statistics from U.N. AIDS, there are over 41 million individuals living with HIV and 1.2 million have been newly diagnosed. Domestically, approximately 1.2 million people live with HIV in the U.S., and about 13% of them do not know they have it, according to HIV.gov.

Founded in 1987, AIDS Healthcare Foundation started as a network of hospices and grassroots advocacy in Los Angeles. It was originally known as the AIDS Hospice Foundation before changing its name to the AIDS Healthcare Foundation in 1990. To date, AHF has healthcare and wellness centers in 50 countries and 19 domestic locations including the District of Columbia and Puerto Rico. AHF provides direct HIV/AIDS services to over 3.2 million individuals in care.

AIDS Healthcare Foundation (AHF), the world’s largest HIV/AIDS healthcare organization, provides cutting-edge medicine and advocacy to more than 3.2 million individuals across 50 countries, including the U.S. and in Africa, Latin America/Caribbean, the Asia/Pacific Region, and Eastern Europe. In January 2025, AHF received the MLK, Jr. Social Justice Award, The King Center’s highest recognition for an organization leading work in the social justice arena. To learn more about AHF, visit us online at AIDShealth.org, find us on Facebook, and follow us on Instagram, Twitter, and TikTok.

Located in Inglewood, California, the Kia Forum is the only arena-sized venue in the country dedicated to music and entertainment, delivering a superior experience for artists and fans alike. The iconic venue hosts a diverse range of premier events, featuring the biggest names in music and entertainment, award shows, combat sports, and more. Fans at the Kia Forum enjoy approximately 8,000 square feet of event-level hospitality offerings, including merchandise and food and beverage options. A tinted glass wall separates this concession area from the arena, ensuring fans do not miss a moment of the show. A 40,000-square-foot outdoor terrace wraps around the perimeter of the building and offers comfortable furnishings and food and beverage options from some of SoCal’s most celebrated brands. Designed with entertainers and performers in mind, Kia Forum Backstage includes star-caliber dressing rooms that provide unparalleled comfort. The Kia Forum received Pollstar's "Arena of the Decade" award in 2022 and was named the top West Coast arena in 2025 by Pollstar and Billboard magazines. thekiaforum.com | Instagram | Facebook | Twitter
